exposure: Time from uterine incision to delivery
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 146 pregnancies with gestational ages of > 37 weeks involving cesarean delivery, divided into two groups: women with one previous cesarean section (n=103) and women with two or more previous cesarean sections (n=43).
finding: The time from uterine incision to delivery did not have a significant effect on neonatal outcomes in patients with one previous and repeat cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study found no effect of time from uterine incision to delivery on neonatal outcomes in women undergoing repeat cesarean sections.
birth_weight: N/A (measured characteristic, not a specific inclusion/exclusion range)
